name: What preparation should I do before an interior remodeling crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: What preparation should I do before an interior remodeling crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by clearing furniture, decor, and fragile items away from the work areas and clearing pathways for the crew to bring in tools and materials. If your project includes custom tile or finish carpentry, having your tile patterns, trim profiles, or paint colors pre-selected prevents mid-project delays. You should also consider whether household routines need adjustment around dust and work noise. The crew protects surrounding floors and fixtures with drop cloths and plastic barriers, but open access allows work to proceed much faster.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture and fragile items from the workspace, establish clear pathways, and finalize paint colors or trim styles beforehand to ensure a smooth, uninterrupted process.
